title: Overview
subtitle: Learn about TaraHive's policies, your privacy, and the terms that govern the use of our services.

blocks.text: Welcome to TaraHive's Policies & Terms. These documents explain how we collect, use, and protect your information, as well as the rules and responsibilities that apply when using TaraHive.

items: Privacy Policy – Explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it.
Terms & Conditions – Describes the rules, responsibilities, and conditions for using TaraHive.

blocks.text: We encourage you to read these documents carefully before using TaraHive. They help you understand your rights, your responsibilities, and our commitment to protecting your privacy while providing our services.
These policies may be updated from time to time. The latest versions will always be available within TaraHive.
